prompt:
Goal: Create a polished anime concept art character sheet for BYAKUYA, a blind samurai and keeper of a jade staff, mixing cyberpunk rooftop atmosphere with traditional ronin design.

Canvas: Vertical poster-style character sheet on an off-white textured paper background, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio. Use clean editorial spacing with dark purple ink accents, thin divider lines, and a premium game art book presentation.

Layout: Left half dominated by a large dynamic full-body action illustration of the samurai leaping or crouching forward on a rain-slick city rooftop at night, neon skyscrapers behind him, purple light reflecting on wet concrete. Top-left has a huge rough brushstroke title reading BYAKUYA, with the subtitle “BLIND SAMURAI / KEEPER OF THE JADE STAFF” beneath it. Right half contains a “TURNAROUND” section with exactly 3 standing character views labeled FRONT, SIDE, and BACK. Below that is a “WEAPON” section showing exactly 1 horizontal jade-ended staff. Below that is a “COLOR PALETTE” section with exactly 4 rough paint swatches labeled JADE, INDIGO, MIDNIGHT, and ANTIQUE GOLD. Bottom-left has a “DETAILS” section with exactly 4 close-up panels: conical hat and shadowed blindfolded face, armored mechanical glove, green sleeve with purple markings, and heavy strapped boot. Bottom-right contains exactly 1 cinematic wide panel of the character standing on a rainy rooftop holding the vertical glowing staff against a purple neon skyline.

Character details: The samurai is a mature male with tan skin, a stern shadowed face, a dark blindfold or obscured eyes under a wide black kasa hat decorated with subtle gold floral motifs. Long white hair streams from beneath the hat. He wears a loose oversized jade green hooded jacket with purple straps and sash ties, dark teal baggy trousers, armored bracers, a black-and-gold mechanical glove, strapped black boots with purple and antique-gold hardware, and a turtle-shell-like brown backpack visible in the back view. His expression and posture should feel calm, dangerous, and disciplined.

Weapon: A long black staff with translucent glowing jade-green crystalline caps at both ends, brass-gold collars, and subtle internal light. In the action pose, the staff should cut diagonally through the composition with strong perspective.

Visual style: High-detail cinematic anime illustration, sharp inked linework, painterly texture, dramatic purple neon rim lighting, rain droplets, glossy wet reflections, splattered indigo paint behind the main figure, cyberpunk city lights, concept-art sheet clarity, moody but readable. Color emphasis should match jade green, deep indigo, midnight blue, antique gold, and neon purple.

Text content: Include the Japanese title “サイレントブレード” above the spaced English title “S I L E N T  B L A D E.” Keep all visible labels crisp and legible: TURNAROUND, FRONT, SIDE, BACK, WEAPON, COLOR PALETTE, JADE, INDIGO, MIDNIGHT, ANTIQUE GOLD, DETAILS.

Constraints: Use exactly the listed sections and counts: 3 turnaround poses, 1 weapon render, 4 color swatches, 4 detail panels, and 1 bottom cinematic panel. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or unrelated text.

promptZh:
目标：为 BYAKUYA 创建一张精致的动漫概念艺术角色设定集。该角色是一位盲眼武士，也是玉杖的守护者，融合了赛博朋克屋顶氛围与传统浪人设计。

画布：竖版海报风格角色设定集，背景为米白色纹理纸，比例约为 2:3。采用整洁的编辑排版，搭配深紫色墨迹点缀、细分割线，呈现出高级游戏美术画册的质感。

布局：左半部分以一张大型动态全身动作插画为主，展示武士在雨夜湿滑的城市屋顶上跳跃或蹲伏，背景为霓虹摩天大楼，紫色灯光映照在潮湿的混凝土上。左上角有巨大的粗笔触标题 BYAKUYA，下方附有副标题“BLIND SAMURAI / KEEPER OF THE JADE STAFF”。右半部分包含一个“TURNAROUND”（三视图）区域，展示 3 个站立角色视图，分别标注为 FRONT（正面）、SIDE（侧面）和 BACK（背面）。下方是“WEAPON”（武器）区域，展示 1 把两端镶玉的横向长杖。再下方是“COLOR PALETTE”（色板）区域，包含 4 个粗糙的色块，分别标注为 JADE（玉色）、INDIGO（靛青）、MIDNIGHT（午夜蓝）和 ANTIQUE GOLD（古董金）。左下角是“DETAILS”（细节）区域，包含 4 个特写面板：斗笠与阴影遮盖的蒙眼面部、机械装甲手套、带有紫色纹饰的绿色袖口，以及带有绑带的厚重靴子。右下角包含 1 个电影感宽幅面板，展示角色站在雨中屋顶，手持垂直发光的长杖，背景为紫色霓虹天际线。

角色细节：武士为成熟男性，肤色偏棕，面部表情严峻且处于阴影中，佩戴黑色宽檐斗笠，斗笠上饰有精致的金色花卉图案，遮住双眼或佩戴深色眼罩。白色长发从斗笠下垂落。他身穿一件宽松的 玉绿色 连帽夹克，配有紫色绑带和腰带，穿着深青色宽松长裤、装甲护腕、黑金配色的机械手套，以及带有紫色和古董金五金件的黑色绑带靴，背面视图可见一个类似龟壳的棕色背包。他的表情和姿态应体现出冷静、危险与纪律感。

武器：一根黑色长杖，两端配有半透明发光的玉绿色水晶头，黄铜金箍，内部带有微弱光芒。在动作姿态中，长杖应以强烈的透视感斜向贯穿整个构图。

视觉风格：高细节电影感动漫插画，锐利的墨线，绘画质感，戏剧性的紫色霓虹轮廓光，雨滴，光泽湿润的反射，主体人物后方有靛青色泼墨效果，赛博朋克城市灯光，概念艺术设定集的清晰度，氛围感强且易于阅读。色彩重点应符合 玉绿色、深靛青、午夜蓝、古董金和霓虹紫。

文本内容：在间距排版的英文标题“S I L E N T  B L A D E”上方加入日文标题“サイレントブレード”。确保所有可见标签清晰易读：TURNAROUND、FRONT、SIDE、BACK、WEAPON、COLOR PALETTE、JADE、INDIGO、MIDNIGHT、ANTIQUE GOLD、DETAILS。

约束条件：严格使用列出的区域和数量：3 个三视图姿态、1 个武器渲染、4 个色块、4 个细节面板和 1 个底部电影感面板。不要添加额外的角色、Logo、水印、UI 元素或无关文本。
